2105-3603-7060-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-7060-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-7060-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2707-4377-7817.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Paradox Shaper by paying {2}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

2023-3499-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1365-2198-2527-2921-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2198-2527-2921-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

1479-2841-3897-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Terramorphic Expanse.
1479-2841-3897-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Terramorphic Expanse.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5170-5231-6132-7918.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3129-7824-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Primal Vigor and Bard.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
3129-7824-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

129-1409-4289-5295.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

457-1409-7156-7306.description:
Activate Arcbound Hybrid by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Arcbound Hybrid leaves and reenters the battlefield, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counters due to its modular ability, and triggering The Ooze and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve Deadeye Navigator's trigger, repairing it and Arcbound Hybrid
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter that was on Arcbound Hybrid when it left the battlefield.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping Arcbound Hybrid and a Mutagen, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
457-1409-7156-7306.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

413-891-5617.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-5921-5970-7297.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2292-3585-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2438-4488-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3967-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
3967-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
3967-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

5742-6089-6786.easyPrerequisites: You have an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card in hand or on top of your library.
5742-6089-6786.description:
Activate Mary Read and Anne Bonny by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and then discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card.
The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Skyswimmer Koi triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card.
Repeat from step 2.

457-3446-5078-5390.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes

81-413-2178-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 5 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
81-413-2178-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters plus one due to Kami of Whispered Hopes on Sin.
When Sin enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it and Kami of Whispered Hopes trigger.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters plus an additional +1/+1 counter on Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Kami of Whispered Hopes trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

2425-6249-6797--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-6249-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2530-2558-4139.description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, causing you to create a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and gain 1 life.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Carnival of Souls and Sword of the Meek trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sword of the Meek trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Thopter.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

2079-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1350-5287-5346.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
1350-5287-5346.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and put them into your graveyard, and create four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}{W}{B}.
Crime Novelist triggers four times, putting four +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dihada from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dihada by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Crystalline Crawler.
2021-2060-3525.description:
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, putting a growth counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Crystalline Crawler.
Repeat until Simic Ascendancy has at least twenty growth counters on it.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's third ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

628-884-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional nontoken non-Human creature with toughness two or greater.
628-884-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Ayara, targeting any other nontoken non-Human creature you control.
Ayara dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Ayara enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability from step 1, putting a -1/-1 counter on the additional creature and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the additional creature, targeting Ayara.
The creature dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
If the creature was black, it enters the battlefield, triggering Ayara, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Ayara and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

3462-3518-4986.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Salvage Scout by paying {W} and sacrificing it, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Salvage Scout from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3510-3703.description:
Play the Forest.
Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling Forest land creature token.
Repeat step 2 infinite times.
